# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security issues privately by opening an issue and mentioning `@git-duck`, or by emailing the repository owner. Do not disclose the issue publicly until it has been addressed.

Reports should include:
- The plugin version and server software used
- Steps to reproduce
- The impact of the issue
